## Features:
All features can be toggled and tweaked via the ModMenu config screen.

| Feature | Description | Additional Settings |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Roll Tilt** | Quake-Style camera tilt when strafing. | `Max Roll Angle`, `Roll Smoothing` |
| **Pitch Tilt** | Forwards/Backwards camera tilting. | `Max Pitch Angle`, `Pitch Smoothing` |
| **FOV** | Much more customisable FOV options. | `Crouch Multiplier`, `Normal Multiplier`, `Sprint Multiplier` |
| ![creeper face](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c38e6a5d96d063e06d95d32ef552f4d97dd03454.png)**Creeper Radar**![warning](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/148a81fd0e5e17f39ecb0ba22467a3931b7cc5b3.png)| Detects creepers within 5 blocks and shows an icon if so. | `Padding`, `Use Creeper Icon`, `Sound Toggle` |
